title.narrative: To reduce tuberculosis prevalence, incidence, and mortality by strengthening integrated care of promotion, prevention and cure services, with a focus on the person, family and community; with support of multisectors and civil society - Guatemala (01-Jul-2025-30-Jun-2028)

description.narrative: Guatemala, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Social Assistance of the Republic of Guatemala (MSPAS)This program has the following goals: Reducir la prevalencia, incidencia, mortalidad y el sufrimiento humano por tuberculosis en el país, fortaleciendo la atención integrada de servicios de promoción, prevención y curación, con enfoque centrado en la persona, la familia y la comunidad; contando con el apoyo e involucramiento multisectorial y de la sociedad civil. / Reduce the prevalence, incidence, mortality and human suffering due to tuberculosis in the country, strengthening integrated care of promotion, prevention and cure services, with a focus on the person, family and community; with the support and involvement of multisectors and civil society.. The objectives of this program are: Fortalecer la prevención y atención integrada e integral de la tuberculosis centrada en la persona, familia, comunidad y su entorno, principalmente en grupos de alto riesgo. / Strengthen integrated and comprehensive prevention and care of tuberculosis focused on the person, family, community and their environment, mainly in high-risk groups.. Fortalecer el compromiso de las comunidades, las organizaciones de la sociedad civil y todos los proveedores de atención públicos y privados para el control de la TB / Strengthen the commitment of communities, civil society organizations and all public and private care providers for TB control. Mejorar la calidad y oportunidad del sistema de información y notificación de casos de TB y mortalidad por TB, / Improve the quality and timeliness of the information and notification system for TB cases and TB mortality,
